name: Equiply Document Editor
description: Convert Word documents, PDFs, images and text into a PDF. Annotate, arrange pages, download or attach to an Equiply job.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'none'; worker-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' data: blob:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data: blob:; frame-src 'self' blob:
